div.div:
LLM agent
Launch ollama-based llm api
Access to given career websites and each job posts in the website
MCP tools
FETCH_HTML: Read each job post in html and convert into readable texts (and usable to llm prompt) and return the results.
FETCH_PDF (optional): Read data/full_resume.pdf and convert the content into proper structured texts.
SAVE_RESULT: collect all features and save them into data/job_list.csv
HANDLE_TEX: read my original tex file, tailor tex file to the job description, and save it to tailored_resumes/...
LLM api: Use html texts (FETCH_HTML) only to extract location, a job title, some key components from job descriptions and do initial screening.
LLM api: Use texts (FETCH_HTML and HANDLE_TEX) from both mcp tools, put them into llm prompt to calculate similarity
(Optional) Embedding api: use document an embedding model to calculate embeddings from my resume and job descriptions and produce similarity
Based on similarity scores, select up to 6 job posts above a threshold score and save them (SAVE_RESULT) into data/job_list.csv with columns: category, company_name, career websites, specific jobID, similarity score, job descriptionURL.
Finally, given job descriptions and original tex file, tailor resume to each job description and save it to pre-defined dir with naming rules.
